description: Enumerate registered node-template asset ids for a node space — the ids you pass to `apply_graph_description` as `$type`. For the scene-nodes (neutron) space, results are filtered to the templates actually addable there (e.g. 'net.maxon.node.invert', 'net.maxon.node.access.composecolor64'); note these differ from the net.maxon.corenode:* ids that `list_graph_nodes` reports for existing nodes. `supported:false` comes back when the C4D build lacks the maxon framework.

node_space.description: Alias 'standard' | 'redshift' | 'scenenodes' (a.k.a. 'neutron') or a fully-qualified maxon.Id. Default 'standard'.

name: list_graph_node_assets
title: List Node Graph Asset Types
